messages:
Samira Patel: Hi all, first-day check-in — Samira here, joining as Product Designer (onboarding flows). Need: Figma + design tokens, access to product roadmap, and where research summaries live. Shortest path?
Ethan (DesignOps): Welcome! :wave: Which email did you sign up with? I can send org invites and also add you to the Design System team so you get tokens.
Samira Patel: samira.patel@redwood.com. Also, anyone know the canonical file for onboarding components?
Maya (Design System): Added you to the DS team in Figma. The component library is under Team > Redwood DS > Components > Onboarding. We use auto-updates, so accept the library to get tokens. If you need tokens in code, grab the token export in the DS page.
Nora_IT: Okta should've provisioned your account. If you don't have Figma, try Request Access: https://okta.redwood.com/apps and search "Figma". For Slack and Notion access I already provisioned you.
Luca (PM): Roadmap is in Notion — Product > Roadmap (team view). For context read the "Onboarding initiative brief" and the 6-week plan. Happy to do a 20m sync Wed 2pm.
Samira Patel: Thanks — Wed works. Where do we keep interview recordings and quick research writeups?
Ethan (DesignOps): Research artifacts live in Dovetail (raw) and we copy synths into Notion under Research > Syntheses. We have a small template: "Research TL;DR" — always include key metrics + 3 recommendations.
Maya (Design System): Tip: to pull token values into Figma use the Tokens plugin. If you need code-ready tokens, ask devops for the token export pipeline (it lives in infra repo).
Nora_IT: If Figma invite doesn't arrive, try internal assist command: ``/request-app figma samira.patel@redwood.com`` (in our Slack app) or DM me and I can trigger a resend.
Samira Patel: I got the Figma invite and the DS team. Seeing 2 files: "Onboarding - V1" and "Onboarding - Patterns". Which is active?
Maya (Design System): "Onboarding - Patterns" is canonical for components. "Onboarding - V1" is a working prototype for the current sprint. Use Patterns for any component changes; sync with me before publishing.
Luca (PM): Also FYI — engineering uses Storybook for visual QA. When you update a component, leave a note in the Product Spec DB and ping eng-review.
devex-bot: Automated: added Samira Patel to "Design System" Figma team and provisioned Notion read access.
Samira Patel: Great, all set. I'll skim the roadmap now and book Wed 2pm. Thanks for the fast help! :thumbsup:
